item.description:

item.title: Hole under the road that tarmac is collapsing into., 24th July
item.description:
There appears to be a hole under the road surface that the tarmac is collapsing into. It’s right on the line a cyclist would take and it’s very hard to see as it’s tarmac collapsing from underneath and under trees. I know it’s there and I’ve still hit it a couple of times - once on a cargo bike causing my child to cry and I nearly lost control of my bike.
